_comment: Soldier traits. 'modifiers' is applied when the soldier is created: morale/loyalty are flat deltas, hp_pct scales starting hit points. attack_pct and move_speed_pct are read by the battle system when a fighting unit is built from a soldier (Step 5), not at recruitment.

traits.name: Cowardly
traits.description: Breaks early when the line falters.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Steps forward when others step back.

traits.name: Steady
traits.description: Does the same thing well, every time.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.description: Counts the pay before the fight.

traits.name: Tough
traits.description: Takes a beating and keeps standing.

traits.name: Frail
traits.description: A bad winter would finish him.

traits.name: Keen-Eyed
traits.description: Sees the gap before it closes.
